questions.solution:
LCM of 16, 24,30, 36 and 45 = 720
Perfect square = 720×5 = 3600
3600=123
Remainder = 33
 16, 24,30, 36 और 45 का LCM = 720
पूर्ण वर्ग = 720×5 = 3600
3600=123×29+33
शेष = 33
